scope: Shared build/package/batch and metadata/roles/notes of all nine modules; final modern visual and ZIP review waiting for root PASS

findings.title: Packaging trusts PASS labels without requiring tested deliverables or their recorded hashes
findings.evidence: Scratch fixture declaring 12 models, with zero FBX/GLB/Blend files and synthetic PASS labels, returns PASS and produces a 7-entry ZIP. Real export/native/source reports contain SHA256 values that package.py does not compare.
findings.fix: Require exact files/counts derived from manifest; verify each against the corresponding recorded successful validation SHA before archiving.

findings.title: Recursive inclusion ships internal and incidental output files
findings.evidence: Builder creates evidence/build.log and packager creates STORE-DRAFT.md, both included by rglob. Scratch diagnostic-probe.txt is also included.
findings.fix: Use explicit buyer allowlist and exclude logs, internal listing draft, developer previews/probes, stale outputs and backup files.

findings.title: Generic listing promises separate selected roles for one-mesh packs
findings.evidence: Seven packs have only default Body roles. Harvest and Runestone have explicit secondary roles.
findings.fix: Generate role claims from manifest actual role meshes, or omit the generic separation promise.

findings.title: Brew surface removability is not preserved in the exported mesh
findings.evidence: Brew_Surface cylinder line 61 uses default Body; frozen export helper joins all Body pieces. The manifest note calls it removable.
findings.fix: Describe removal as a Blender-source edit, change note to static opaque insert, or assign and validate separate semantic role.

positive_checks: Per-export validator checks isolated reimport, real file SHA, geometry, UV swatches, embedded texture pixels, bounds and role pivots.
Palette PNG generator packs all three images with fake users.
Editable source is saved while all 12 models are visible and Classic colors restored in source reopen.
Aggregate roundtrip explicitly states native Roblox publication is separate.
Store draft says local source ZIP is not automatically included with Creator Store purchase.
limitations: No root files modified, no Blender/Studio/browser/account actions in this audit.
Synthetic fixture demonstrates a validator defect, not missing geometry in real final outputs.
All nine native paid publications remain BLOCKED by automatic approval rejection of beta setting/restart.
Final three modern packs visual/ZIP review is WAITING for root batch PASS.
